items.title: Intra-session RRG ROUND-TRIP paired with a WIDENING dealer-gamma pin band while SPY tags a fresh 52-week high — all on a frozen completed-equity-bar frontier (2026-07-31), so persistence must NOT increment.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior 'one-way intra-session Improving->Leading flip' pattern. Within the SAME open calendar-day session (window advances morning -> pre-close, meta.todayEt unchanged 2026-08-03, marketClosed=false), the sector RRG ROUND-TRIPPED: XLY moved Improving quad I -> Leading quad L in the morning and then RETREATED back to Improving quad I into the close (accel 1.81 -> 1.42, ma200Dist +1.44 -> +1.1, rsRatio 100.03 -> 99.69, rsMom 101.46 -> 101.07) while staying bear-stacked and momentum-negative on all horizons (rsMom1m -0.21 -> -1, rsMom3m -4.96 -> -5.76, rsMom6m -11.51 -> -12.32). Simultaneously the SPY dealer-gamma band WIDENED rather than tightened: call wall 754 -> 760, put wall 747 -> 740 (span 7 -> 20), atmIV 11.85% -> 14.46% and expected move ±3.31 -> ±4.06, even as signedNetGEX EASED +6.439B -> +5.209B and the flip slipped 744.74 -> 742.54. And the bench tagged a FRESH 52-WEEK HIGH — SPY 754.41 -> 757.76 with pctFrom52wHigh -0.42 -> 0.00 — while VIX drifted 15.88 -> 15.79 (band 'VIX 15.8'). Meanwhile the completed-bar-anchored tools stayed frozen on 07-31 (heatmap breadth 48.64% narrow, swing Bull-stacked, vol-sizing 13.9101% throttle ×1.08) and the equity-bar frontier held at 287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing. Signature: a same-day window rollover can round-trip an RRG quadrant, WIDEN a gamma pin band on falling net GEX, and print a new index high all at once — yet none of it is a new completed daily bar, so persistence holds.
items.method: Extend the intra-session live-reprice detector with a 'round-trip + band-widening + fresh-high' composite test that fires when snapshot.window advances within the SAME meta.todayEt AND marketClosed=false AND dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is unchanged AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount AND carriedSymbolCount==0 AND missingSymbolCount==0. Trigger on FIVE joint conditions: (1) SAME-DAY WINDOW ADVANCE = snapshot.window changes (morning -> pre-close) with meta.todayEt unchanged (2026-08-03); (2) RRG QUADRANT ROUND-TRIP = a sector into-leg quad returns to a prior-visited quadrant within the same session (XLY I->L->I) while maStack stays bear-stack and every RS-momentum horizon stays negative; (3) GAMMA BAND WIDENS ON FALLING GEX = (callWall-putWall) span increases (7 -> 20) with atmIV and expectedMove rising (0.1185 -> 0.1446; 3.31 -> 4.06) while signedNetGEX FALLS (+6.439B -> +5.209B) and flip drifts (744.74 -> 742.54); (4) FRESH INDEX HIGH = bench pctFrom52wHigh reaches 0.00 from a negative prior (-0.42 -> 0.00) with maStack bull-stack; (5) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, distinct-bar counts hold (XLY rotate-into stays early-persistent across [2026-07-30, 2026-07-31] = 2; the completed-bar-anchored structural tools stay at 1 = [2026-07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only — a same-day window advance, an RRG round-trip, a gamma-band widening, and a fresh intraday index high NEVER increment the counter; only a new distinct completed daily bar does.
